messages:
Ravi Menon: Quick sync — launch tomorrow at 09:00 PT for the feature + benchmark post. This thread to confirm embargo list, spokespersons, and emergency rollback comms.
Ravi Menon: Key asks: 1) final press contact list by EOD; 2) spokesperson availability window (CEO + Head of Eng); 3) fallback messaging if metric numbers need correction after publish.
Sophie Hart: I'm updating the press list now. Suggest top press T-1h, analyst T-2h. Will ping partners for syndication windows. Sheet: https://sheets.internal/launch/press-1805
Marta Ruiz: Spokesperson availability: CEO available 08:30-10:30 PT for quotes/interviews. Head of Eng on-call 08:00-11:00 PT. I've added both to the calendar invite.
Ravi Menon: Rollback comms plan: short note + social hold. If we find a data error, we pull the post and send an update tweet with transparent correction and link to corrected methods. Draft canned messages in the doc.
PressOps Bot: Social drafts queued and held. Will send once @Ravi posts GO. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
ops-bot: Health check scheduled at 08:50 PT for publish infra (CDN, link-check, image assets). Will report status here.
Sophie Hart: Legal asked we avoid absolute phrasing like "unbeatable" in the headline. Rewrote to "significantly faster in our tests" — please review.
Marta Ruiz: Localization note: FR/DE/JP pages will be live at T+15m. We'll embargo syndicated copies accordingly.
Ravi Menon: Thanks — final checklist:
```
- press list locked (Sophie)
- spokespersons confirmed (Marta)
- legal-approved headline (Sophie)
- assets uploaded to CDN (ops-bot)
- social queued (PressOps Bot)
```
Ravi Menon: I'll give GO at 08:55 PT if ops-bot health is green. Leave any last asks here.
